_comment: When a medal is awarded. The C holds none: the rows start unused and the build writes these (at most 16); a medal with no row here is never awarded by the game itself (the story can still award it). when = [kind, numbers]: allTriggers [first, count] all set; wins [n] tournament wins >= n; allCards [trigger] every card owned and that trigger set (-1: none); allMoves [n] the first n techniques learned; stats [hpMp, others] all six base stats at least; money [n] exactly; year [n] exactly; allRaised [first, end] the species first..end-1 raised once; fish [n] caught >= n. checkedBy: tick = every tamer tick, script = the card-trader routine (the textbox shown is `text`). levelUp raises the tamer level.

medals.note: all six cups D, C, B, A, S, R won (triggers 15-20)
the seven attribute cups, Fire to Filth (triggers 26-32)
every partner species 1..61 raised once; the tamer level goes up
all six base stats at the original maximum: HP and MP 9999, the rest 999
all 66 cards and the game beaten once (trigger 50), for the card trader
